text:
emma: Heads-up: opened PR to update SDK snippet + migration note for v3. Holding merge until streaming feature-flag is live in prod. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
pr-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-1234 — snapshot ready :white_check_mark:
sam: Quick check — python snippet uses `client.generate(..., stream=True)`. SDK v3 renamed the arg to `streaming=True`. Will that be out-of-sync?
maya: Good catch, thanks @sam. I'll push a tiny commit to update the example to `streaming=True` and add a short migration note.
emma: Thanks @maya. @lee what's the rollout ETA for the streaming FF? We need to line up merge before docs freeze (cutoff Tue 23:59 UTC).
lee: Rollout plan: canary start Tue 18:00 UTC, progressive ramp. Target 100% by Wed 06:00 UTC. Docs-safe merge after canary passes — aim Wed 02:00 UTC for safety.
oliver: If docs go live earlier we might advertise streaming to customers who don't have the FF. Can we gate the page with a banner + note about FF availability?
emma: Prefer not to publish consumer-facing docs that are misleading. I'll add a prominent banner: "Applies to customers with streaming feature flag" and hold merge until Wed 02:15 UTC. OK?
sam: Also FYI CI preview flagged a flaky test in `render-nav.spec.js` earlier; log excerpt: ```Error: Navigation render timeout at 3000ms``` Not blocking this PR but worth watching.
pr-bot: CI: all checks passing after @maya's fix. Preview updated: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-1234/changes — reviewable.
lee: Good — I'll confirm canary health and post a thumbs-up here once passed (expected Tue 23:30 UTC).
emma: Thanks everyone. Plan: merge at Wed 02:20 UTC unless objections. If canary lags we'll postpone and ping release. :thumbsup:
